mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
ORDER BY p.sales_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.id >= COALESCE(( SELECT FLOOR(MIN(seed_p.id) + RAND() * GREATEST(MAX(seed_p.id) - MIN(seed_p.id), 1)) FROM product seed_p WHERE seed_p.deleted = 0 AND seed_p.status = 1 AND seed_p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seckill_activity_apply saa JOIN seckill_activity sa ON sa.id = saa.activity_id WHERE saa.product_id = seed_p.id AND saa.audit_status = 1 AND sa.publish_status = 1 AND sa.end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ), 0) ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, c.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM category c INNER JOIN product p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seckill_activity_apply saa JOIN seckill_activity sa ON sa.id = saa.activity_id WHERE saa.product_id = p.id AND saa.audit_status = 1 AND sa.publish_status = 1 AND sa.end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ORDER BY c.sort_order

SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.id IN
#{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalProducts, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS onShelfCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS offShelfCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN stock IS NOT NULL AND stock <= #{lowStockThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lowStockCount, IFNULL(SUM(sales_count), 0) AS totalSales, IFNULL(SUM(sales_count * price), 0) AS estimatedRevenue FROM product WHERE deleted = 0 AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY p.sales_count DESC, p.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT IFNULL(c.id, 0) AS categoryId, IFNULL(c.name, '未分类') AS categoryName, COUNT(p.id) AS productCount, IFNULL(SUM(p.sales_count), 0) AS totalSales, IFNULL(SUM(p.sales_count * p.price), 0) AS totalRevenue FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY totalSales DESC, productCount DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, sales_count = sales_count + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, sales_count = GREATEST(0, sales_count - #{quantity}) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count, IFNULL(SUM(p.sales_count), 0) AS total_sales, IFNULL(SUM(p.sales_count * p.price), 0) AS total_revenue FROM category c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT p.category_id AS categoryId, COALESCE(c.name, '未分类') AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id
GROUP BY p.category_id, c.name ORDER BY count DESC, categoryId ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.price < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket0_99, SUM(CASE WHEN p.price >= 100 AND p.price < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket100_299, SUM(CASE WHEN p.price >= 300 AND p.price < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket300_999, SUM(CASE WHEN p.price >= 1000 AND p.price < 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket1000_2999, SUM(CASE WHEN p.price >= 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket3000_plus, COUNT(*) AS totalMatched FROM product p

SELECT name FROM product WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seckill_activity_apply saa JOIN seckill_activity sa ON sa.id = saa.activity_id WHERE saa.product_id = product.id AND saa.audit_status = 1 AND sa.publish_status = 1 AND sa.end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) AND name IS NOT NULL AND name != '' ORDER BY sales_count DESC, rating DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT name FROM category WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name != '' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT jt.tag FROM product p JOIN JSON_TABLE( p.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( tag VARCHAR(100) PATH '$' ) ) jt WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seckill_activity_apply saa JOIN seckill_activity sa ON sa.id = saa.activity_id WHERE saa.product_id = p.id AND saa.audit_status = 1 AND sa.publish_status = 1 AND sa.end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) AND jt.tag IS NOT NULL AND jt.tag != '' ORDER BY jt.tag ASC LIMIT #{limit}
